ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-green cubes with firm edges and slightly translucent flesh, about 2 cm per side, arranged in a cluster of roughly 5 pieces at the upper part of the leaves, matte surface with faint sheen | 60
ITEM 2 | Small golden-brown cube with a rough, slightly crumbly exterior and dense interior, about 2 cm across, sitting at the upper right edge of the plate, dry surface with light browning | 12
ITEM 3 | Whole dark blue berries, about 1 cm diameter, glossy and smooth skin with a dusty bloom, clustered in a loose group of about 15 berries on the right side next to the strawberries | 30
ITEM 4 | Red strawberries, halved and quartered, about 2-3 cm pieces with bright red flesh, moist surface, some seeds visible, arranged in a cluster on the right side beside the blueberries | 55
ITEM 5 | Dark green spinach-like leaves, mostly wilted and flat, moist with a slight sheen, forming a bed across the center of the plate, leaves about 5-10 cm long | 45
ITEM 6 | Small whole red cherry tomato, about 2 cm diameter, smooth glossy skin, firm and round, sitting on the left edge of the greens | 12
ITEM 7 | Thin orange shreds, about 4-6 cm long and 2 mm wide, slightly glossy, crisp-looking strips scattered over and among the greens | 8
ITEM 8 | Light dressing or oil film, thin and slightly glossy, visible as a faint sheen on the leaves and plate near the greens | 5
